title: Doctor internet presence registry seed (proposed)
method: owner list from chat + release/doctors files + one web-search pass per person; nothing fetched for ingestion
rules: displayId is a stable label, never reused; removal changes selection, not the id
all endpoints PENDING_VERIFICATION; none feeds the automatic content flow until verified
locatorGuess is text extracted from search notes and must be resolved to a canonical locator before registration
credentialClass defaults to UNKNOWN_PENDING_VERIFICATION; only Sayer Ji and Anthony William are placed in OTHER_HEALTH_ACTORS per the earlier owner decision
REMOVED people keep their displayId and record; they are excluded from the activity matrix

owner decision 2026-10-29: newsletter and Bluesky channels are out of scope; NEWSLETTER endpoints keep their record with scope OUT_OF_SCOPE and are excluded from the activity matrix and scoring; Bluesky endpoints are not registered
owner decision 2026-10-30: TikTok and LinkedIn channels are out of scope; their endpoints keep their record with scope OUT_OF_SCOPE and are excluded from the activity matrix and scoring
owner decision 2026-10-30: academic publication channel (ACADEMIC_PROFILE, PubMed) is out of scope; endpoints keep their record with scope OUT_OF_SCOPE and are excluded from the activity matrix
